$comment: Hard gzip budgets in KiB for bundled+minified ESM with optional peers externalized. These are reviewed release limits, not generated baselines. The measured growth above the previous limits is attributable to bounded composed-focus traversal and external-label association; inherited locale/direction observation; mutation-safe ARIA ownership; bounded readonly event-detail snapshots; rendered-state and accessibility-visibility guards; and text-quote resolution. Family-specific weight is concentrated in multi-split and drilldown-panel layout, condition-builder and data-grid processing, PDF/GeoJSON/PPTX viewers, chart accessibility, media animation/map behavior, and toast/alert state handling. Metafile inspection confirms those owned modules account for the increase and that no optional peer or foreign dependency became eager; the peer-inclusive exclusion checks remain blocking. The button canary measures 42.0 KiB gzip: its increase from 31.3 KiB is accounted for by LyraElement snapshots, composed-focus/external-label behavior, inherited-context observation, ARIA relationships, localization, and its compatibility styles rather than a dependency leak. Changed ceilings are integer-KiB round-ups of measured size plus at most the established 4% policy margin; hydration, SSR, and gauge retain their prior ceilings.
